messages:
mira: Heads-up — after the RBAC inheritance refactor (deploy last night) a service principal with only project scope briefly got an org-level effective role on a KMS decrypt. Seeing it in PROD.

sam: where's the evidence?

mira: quick log extract from the decrypt path:
```
time=2026-03-20T02:12:11Z req=req-0a1b2c auth=svc-acct-42 scope=project:proj-33 claim_org=org-77 effective_role=org_admin resource_org=org-99 resource_workspace=ws-88
action=KMS.Decrypt status=200
```

mira: note claim_org vs resource_org mismatch. service principal had no explicit org binding but inheritance code filled an org claim based on project metadata — which is wrong in certain namespace-affinity edge cases.

ops-bot: :warning: Alert triggered: cross-org KMS decrypt detected (req-0a1b2c) — severity=high — auto-created INC-2026-104

jen: which rollout introduced the change? can we revert fast?

sam: PR is #4389 "inherit-refactor-v2" — it changed how we materialize org claims for principals referenced through project namespace lookups. I’ll start a revert if ops approves.

rik: hold on before full revert — we should patch the claim resolution logic. current flow does:
```
if claimant.project_id:
  claims.org = lookup_project_owner(claimant.project_id)  # previous behavior
```
We unintentionally allowed a project->org mapping for service principals that shouldn't get org-level perms. Fix is to not synthesize org claim for service principals unless they have an explicit org binding.

mira: agreed. quick mitigation: block KMS decrypts when auth type == svc-acct and resource_org != explicit_claim_org. fallback to deny if no explicit org.

sam: creating hotfix branch now (patch + test). also logging improvement: emit audit field reason=claim-materialization to make queries easy.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Started deploy: hotfix/4389-claim-sanitizer -> staging (by sam).

jen: add an alert rule: if KMS.Decrypt where effective_role in (org_admin, org_owner) and principal_type==svc-acct and resource_org != principal_org then page sec-oncall.

security-bot: Incident INC-2026-104 created. Assigned: mira, sam. Pager duty: sec-oncall. Audit link: https://redwood.atlassian/INC-2026-104

rik: postmortem notes to include: missing unit tests for service-principal claim paths, missing invariant that org assignment must be explicit, and lack of an audit-only detector for cross-org crypto ops.

mira: quick repro steps for the team: 1) create svc-acct scoped to project X, 2) invoke token resolution via namespace-affinity proxy where project metadata owner != resource org, 3) call KMS.Decrypt on resource in other org. I can repro in non-prod in ~30s.

sam: hotfix applied to staging; running integration tests. If green, will rollback prod PR and apply hotfix there.

jen: rolling rollback in prod now (ops-bot should show steps).

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Rollback initiated: revert PR #4389 -> production. Started at 2026-03-20T02:14:05Z.

mira: action items: [mira] confirm no further cross-org decrypts in last 24h, [sam] land hotfix + tests, [rik] add auditing rule + alert, [jen] validate rollback + post-deploy scans.

sam: will follow up with a short RFC for a stricter claim-materialization policy (no auto-org-assignment).
